recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, solarized collage of four figures arranged around a central glowing blue orb. The aesthetic utilizes a heavy CRT-scanline or halftone texture with a primary palette of red, green, and yellow against a deep black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures encircling a central luminous focal point
Text block integrated into the central negative space
Rhythmic repetition of Pan-African colors across different subjects
coreInvariants: Extreme black shadows with zero detail
Solarized color fringes on skin and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four human figures occupy the quadrants of the frame, scaled to fill the square composition while leaving a central void for text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A central, glowing blue concentric circle or speaker-like orb.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion starting from the top-right face, moving clockwise around the central orb, ending at the central text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black voids between figures and at the extreme corners.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow and Green (highlights and mid-tones on skin)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red (lower text and warm highlights) and Cyan (central orb)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Hyper-saturated colors against absolute black; no subtle gradients, only hard solarized transitions.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the central dark void between figures

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color-coding to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the original.
Provides the necessary verticality and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast collage of four people's faces and shoulders arranged in a circle. Apply a heavy solarization effect and a CRT scanline texture. Use a palette of neon green, bright yellow, and deep red highlights against a pitch-black background. Place a glowing cyan concentric circle in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of stacked, left-aligned, uppercase condensed sans-serif text in the center-right. Color the top line green, the middle line yellow, and the bottom line red.

verificationChecks: Is the texture visibly grainy or scanline-based?
Are the shadows pure black without detail?
Is the text color-coded in the green-yellow-red sequence?
Does the central orb have a cyan/blue glow?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no facial features are recognizable from the source.
Check that the scanline effect covers the entire image.
Verify the text is perfectly legible despite the heavy background texture.
Confirm the central orb acts as a visual anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solarized High-Contrast Portraiture + CRT Texture + Tri-Color Stacked Typography
